seo.title: Send a digital help request
seo.description: A simple, guarded form to send your digital problem to a real developer for clear, human advice.
seo.keywords: digital help request, simple tech support form, ask a developer, free internet assistance

title: Tell me where you are stuck
subtitle: Be specific. The more details you give me about what you clicked and what happened, the faster I can help.
formNote: A real human reads this. If I can solve it, I will reply directly to your email with simple instructions. If I need more details to understand the issue, I will ask.

fields.email: Your email address (so I can reply)

detailsPlaceholder: e.g., I am using my laptop and trying to print a PDF document, but every time I click Print, an error says 'printer offline' even though the cable is plugged in...
successTitle: Message received. You are in the queue.
successBody: I will read your request and reply to your email directly as soon as I can.
error: Something went wrong sending the message. Please try clicking send again.
